title: What Corporate Buzzword Is Your Soul?
dek: Deep down, past the quarterly goals, there is a single phrase that defines you. Let's take this offline and find out which.
author: dirk-hotfix

questions.q: A meeting runs 10 minutes over. You:

answers.a: Suggest we combine it with the next meeting. Efficiency!
Say I have a hard stop. I don't. I just want to leave.
Propose we table the last item and revisit it next week.
Ask a question that adds 20 more minutes.
Point out the one thing we could fix right now, easily.

questions.q: Your manager asks if you can take on a new project. You say:

answers.a: 'Absolutely, I see so much overlap with what I'm already doing.'
'Let me check my bandwidth.' (My bandwidth is zero.)
'Love it. Let's circle back once Q3 wraps.'
'Before I commit, I'd love to really understand the problem space.'
'Are there any quick wins we can grab first?'
A trail mix where every ingredient is working together.
Nothing. I'm too busy to snack. I eat at my desk at 3 p.m.
The donut I said I'd come back for. I'll come back for it.
A seven-layer dip. I'm getting to the bottom of it.
A literal apple from the bowl. It was right there.
A quote about teamwork from a CEO who was later indicted.
'Responses may be delayed due to high volume.'
'Sent from my phone, more soon!' (There is never more.)
Links to three articles I've written about my process.
Just my name. Simple. Effective. A quick win.

questions.q: It's Friday at 4:45 p.m. Someone pings you with a 'quick question.' You:

answers.a: Loop in three more people so we can solve it together.
Set my status to 'In a meeting' and close the laptop.
Reply 'Great question! Monday?' and feel great about it.
Answer with a 900-word message and a diagram.
Answer it in five words. Done. Weekend.

questions.q: What would your coworkers say about you at your retirement party?

answers.a: 'They brought people together. Constantly. Against their will.'
'They always seemed so busy. We never figured out with what.'
'They promised to follow up on my 2019 proposal. Still waiting.'
'They asked a lot of questions. A lot of questions.'
'They fixed the printer once and never let us forget it.'

synergy.title: Synergy
synergy.body: You believe that two things together are better than two things apart, and you'll prove it by combining every meeting, project and Slack channel into one terrifying super-meeting. You see connections everywhere. Some of them are real. Your soul is a Venn diagram where every circle is labeled 'alignment.'
synergy.share: My soul is 'Synergy': I will combine your meeting with my meeting.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.body: You are always at capacity. Always. Nobody has ever seen you with free time, including you. When someone asks for help you say 'let me check my bandwidth' like you're a home router. Your soul is buffering. It has been buffering since 2019.
bandwidth.share: My soul is 'Bandwidth': I don't have it, and I never will.

circleback.title: Let's Circle Back
circleback.body: You are a master of gentle postponement. Every hard decision, awkward conversation and unwanted task gets lovingly placed in the future, where it lives forever. You aren't avoiding things. You're scheduling them for a date that will never come. Your soul is a calendar invite with no time attached.
circleback.share: My soul is 'Let's Circle Back': I will get back to you on what that means.

deepdive.title: Deep Dive
deepdive.body: You never just look at something. You go into it. A simple question becomes a 40-slide investigation, a spreadsheet with tabs, and a follow-up meeting to discuss the findings. Your coworkers fear the phrase 'let's go deeper on this,' because you mean it. Your soul has no bottom. It's just more slides.
deepdive.share: My soul is 'Deep Dive': I turned your yes-or-no question into a 40-slide deck.

fruit.title: Low-Hanging Fruit
fruit.body: You see the easy win, and you take it, and you tell everyone about it. Why climb the tree when the fruit is right here at eye level? You've built a whole career on things that were always going to work. Honestly? Respect. Your soul is a single grape in a break room, and you're proud of it.
fruit.share: My soul is 'Low-Hanging Fruit': I fixed the printer once and I'm still talking about it.
